offering_description.value: Kadant supplies custom-engineered equipment, components, and automation tools to process industries. Its offerings cover flow control, cleaning and filtration, fiber and wood processing, and bulk and discrete material handling. It sells products and services worldwide through its subsidiaries.

quotes.quote: We are a global supplier of technologies and engineered systems that drive Sustainable Industrial Processing®. Our products and services play an integral role in enhancing efficiency, optimizing energy utilization, and maximizing productivity in process industries.
Kadant brand products and services are sold to industries worldwide through our subsidiaries located in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia.

primary_products.value: Fluid, power, and data transfer equipment; doctoring, cleaning, and filtration systems; fiber and wood processing machinery; conveying and baling equipment; industrial automation and equipment monitoring tools

quotes.quote: Our brand portfolio carries a rich heritage of product innovation with well-known industry names including AES, Johnson, Lodding, Unaflex, and Vickery. Our primary products include rotary sealing devices, steam systems, expansion joints, doctor systems, roll and fabric cleaning devices, and filtration and fiber recovery systems. With deep application expertise and a proven track record, we help customers reduce energy consumption, improve machine runnability, and build long-term operational sustainability.
